item.description:
YouTube 21.42.4 | YTKACE 1.1.4 | YTKACE_1.1.4_YouTube_21.42.4

What's new: • Updated to YouTube 21.42.4 • Added a SponsorBlock button to the player to whitelist channels, vote on segments and submit new ones • Added Report AI Channels to report channels to AiSList from the ⋯ menu • Added Clean Copied Links to remove tracking like si= from links you copy or share • Added options to remove items from the ⋯ menu • Added Tab Bar options for Liquid Glass: Default, YTKACE, YouTube or Off • Added Keep Shorts in Home, Search and on Channels

item.title: Streamyfin v0.55.2
item.description:
Streamyfin 0.55.2 | streamyfin-ios
## What's Changed
0.55.2 is another bug fix release. One thing does change: a TV is now signed in from your phone with Quick Connect, so Quick Connect has to be on in your server's dashboard (it is by default) and both devices need this version. The rest again comes out of the crash and error reports, plus a round of fixes to accounts and the Seerr sign-in
Thanks to everyone who reported a problem, and to @Gauvino for the Quick Connect and Seerr fixes!
### ✨ Highlights - **Signing a TV in from your phone uses Quick Connect**, with a code or a QR code, and no longer sends your password over the local network (#2240) by @Gauvino - **Freezes of a few seconds when playback starts or resumes** on iOS and tvOS are fixed (#2205) by @fredrikburmester - **Access tokens are kept out of the app log**, including the logs you export, and entries written by earlier versions are cleaned up (#2103) by @Gauvino - **Seerr access no longer carries over** to the next account signed in on the same device (#2233) by @Gauvino - **Quick Connect in Settings** sends the code on its sixth digit and tells you why a code fails (#2246) by @Gauvino - **Luxembourgish** is available as an app language (#2195) by @Gauvino
### 🎬 Player - iOS and tvOS: the app no longer freezes for several seconds when playback starts or resumes while the system audio service is slow to answer (#2205) by @fredrikburmester - Music: tapping a track far down the queue before the rest has loaded no longer fails, and neither do previous and next with repeat all (#2212) by @fredrikburmester
### 📺 TV - Pairing a TV with a phone goes through Quick Connect: the TV shows a code and a QR code, your phone approves it, and the TV signs in by itself. No password travels between the two devices, and the TV picks its own server (#2240) by @Gauvino - On the phone, Settings > Log in on TV scans the QR code or takes the code typed in, and the entry now shows on iPhones too (#2240) by @Gauvino - The TV offers a new code when the old one runs out after ten minutes, and says so when Quick Connect is turned off on the server (#2240) by @Gauvino - "Save this account" works with a Quick Connect sign-in: the TV asks how to protect the account before showing the code (#2240) by @Gauvino - The TV signs in as the phone's user, and a TV still on an older version has to be updated before it can be paired (#2240) by @Gauvino - Switching account on a TV no longer leaves the previous account's Seerr session and plugin settings in place for the next one (#2197, #2233) by @Gauvino
### 🔑 Sign-in & Accounts - Settings > Quick Connect sends the code on its sixth digit or when you paste one, and shows why a code failed under the cells instead of in a dialog, with the code kept for a fix (#2246) by @Gauvino - Approving a Quick Connect code while Quick Connect is turned off on the server no longer signs you out. The app tells you it is off instead (#2246, #2247) by @Gauvino - iOS: the toolbar with a "Default" button above the number pad is gone from the Quick Connect code and the account PIN fields, and a tap beside the field closes the keyboard (#2236, #2242) by @Gauvino - Settings from the Streamyfin plugin are applied right after signing in, Quick Connect included, instead of at the next refresh (#2197) by @Gauvino - The Seerr sign-in that follows a login runs right away, and only once (#2197, #2231) by @Gauvino - One account's Seerr session, and the Seerr and OpenSubtitles keys the plugin gave it, no longer reach the next account signed in on the device (#2197, #2233) by @Gauvino
### ⬇️ Downloads - An item with nothing to download, like a folder, a photo or a book, shows a message instead of doing nothing (#2210) by @fredrikburmester - Downloading the last missing episode of a season uses that episode's own version, audio and subtitle tracks, not the first episode's (#2214) by @fredrikburmester
### 🐛 Fixes - Access tokens are redacted from the app log and from exported logs, and entries written before this update are redacted too. On iOS the name of an external subtitle track carried the token into the log (#2103) by @Gauvino - Opening a library sends one request with that library's own sort and filters, instead of a first one carrying the previous library's (#2256) by @fredrikburmester - The Live TV guide and the item counts on library cards load when they open before the session has been restored, instead of staying empty (#2209) by @fredrikburmester - Streamystats: an answer without results no longer breaks the home recommendation rows and search (#2203) by @fredrikburmester - A custom link the in-app browser cannot open is handed to the system, and one that nothing can open shows a message instead of doing nothing (#2211) by @fredrikburmester - Fixed an error after restarting the app when something had been changed while offline, like marking an item as played (#2208) by @fredrikburmester - iOS: custom header values can be read when the system starts the app in the background on a locked phone, once this version has been opened one time (#2215) by @fredrikburmester and @Gauvino
### 🔧 Build & Infra - Crash reporting sends less: more network and proxy failures the app can do nothing about are skipped (#2204) by @fredrikburmester - Routine dependency updates (#1874) by @renovate[bot] and @Gauvino
### 🌍 Translations - Luxembourgish (Lëtzebuergesch) is available in the language picker (#2195) by @Gauvino - Ongoing Crowdin sync (#2095, #2213, #2241) by our translators on Crowdin - Want to help translate Streamyfin? Join us at [translate.streamyfin.app](https://translate.streamyfin.app)
### 🛟 Support & Reporting Bugs
- **Bugs and feature requests:** [open an issue](https://github.com/streamyfin/streamyfin/issues/new/choose). Search [existing issues](https://github.com/streamyfin/streamyfin/issues) first and add to a match if there is one. - **Questions and help:** [Discord](https://discord.streamyfin.app)
**Include in bug reports:** app version, platform and device, OS version, Jellyfin server version, direct play or transcoding, the media's codecs and subtitle format, which player you used (native or standard), steps to reproduce, and logs or a screen recording if possible.
**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/streamyfin/streamyfin/compare/v0.55.1...v0.55.2

Synkplay 0.26.0 | synkplay-0.26.0-ios
> This release is not on Google Play or the App Store yet. We're approaching the v1.0 stable release. [KitePlayer](https://github.com/yuroyami/KitePlayer) is also looking promising to be the default player on iOS (VLC has always been such a mess to work with). I urge you to test KitePlayer which is a player I made specifically for the Kotlin multiplatform framework to match mpv and VLC capabilities. Be one of its first testers. I'd love the feedback. Note that it still does NOT support TrueHDR and HLS. Probably will add it in a not-so-far upcoming release.

Changelog since v0.25.0

 - Extended iOS support for picture-in-picture to AVPlayer and KitePlayer. - Implemented secure connection support for servers hosted by the user in the mobile app (and when a server's certificate is not trusted by the system, the app shows its fingerprint and lets you decide). - Small drifts between watchers are now corrected with a speed change of 0.5% which nobody notices instead of a jump. - Headset buttons, the lock screen and the notification no longer pause or seek the whole room by accident. On a TV, the remote's media keys still control the room. - Show a non-generic explicitly-defined error when a connection fails. - New Feature: Home keeps your 5 recent rooms remembered (under the join key). - New Feature: ExoPlayer now loads chapters from MKV and MP4 files, and each chapter shows a still frame taken from around the time the chapter starts. - Enhanced focus control for Android TV. - The seek bar shows what is buffered with mpv, KitePlayer and AVPlayer. - An audio or subtitle track that you pick now is remembered with the next file by its language. - Subtitle searches now send the episode and the file's hash for better matches. - Shared playlist quality-of-life change: Media folders show when the app lost access to them + a playlist file that none of your folders holds is now marked as such (and you can point the app to it). - The in-app hosted server now limits connections and drops a client that floods it. - A chat line or a playlist change can no longer reach the server twice after a reconnect. - Joining from an invite link, a shortcut or a Quick Action now works at any time. - Screen readers: the room controls stay on screen while a screen reader runs. - Android: you can pick the app's language in the system's per-app language setting. - Android: added a baseline profile inside the APK which makes the app start faster. - In-room notifications/notices now fade in and out instead appearing/disappearing out of nowhere. - iOS VLC: updated to VLCKit 4.0.0a24. - Updated KitePlayer from 0.0.27 to 0.2.0 on both iOS and Android. Major performance gains come with it. - The log now hides identifying details and limits its size.

item.title: Onside TV v3.0.0
item.description:
Onside TV 3.0.0 | OnsideTV_V3.0.0
### **Nebulo is now Onside TV!** Same app, new name, and the biggest update so far.
### **Read this before you install** - **You need iOS 26 or newer.** If your phone is on an older version, stay on Nebulo V2.3 for now. - **Onside TV installs as a new app next to Nebulo.** You'll have to log in again, and your favorites and settings from Nebulo won't carry over. Once you're set up you can delete Nebulo. - **There's just one IPA this time**, no backup version.
### **What's New** - **New look:** Liquid Glass all through the app, a new home screen with big channel cards and a full screen hero at the top. - **Way bigger sports section:** Game cards with lineups, stats, momentum, shot maps, win probability and box scores, plus standings, team pages and schedules. - **Favorite teams:** Follow your teams, leagues, drivers and golfers and see their next game or live score on the home screen. - **Live Activities:** Follow the score from your Lock Screen and Dynamic Island. - **Smarter game search:** Tap a game and the app checks your TV guide for both teams around the start time, then plays the right channel or shows you the best matches. - **New search:** Live games, recently watched channels and your categories all in one place. - **Recordings:** Stop, delete or jump to the live channel right from the recordings section, and recordings now show their own guide info. - **Connection warning:** If your provider only gives you one connection, the app warns you before watching something else would cut off a recording.
### **Fixes** - If your login is wrong the app now tells you, instead of dropping you on an empty home screen. The guide also loads right away the first time you log in. - Streams don't keep playing sound anymore after you close them and lock your phone. - Smoother scrolling and less heat. - Show pictures on the home screen only appear when they actually match the show.
### **Under the Hood** - The code is open source now under the MIT license. - Update checks still come from GitHub, so you'll get a heads up in Settings when a new version is out.
Questions or bugs? Come say hi in the [Discord](https://discord.gg/msq2tcd5Rg) or [open an issue](https://github.com/mongoosemonke504/OnsideTV/issues).

item.description: Fladder 0.11.1 | Fladder-iOS-0.11.1 ## What's Changed Release is v0.11.1 is a hot-fix release for v0.11.0 mainly fixing local network connections not working on Android. Besides that the changelog remains the same. ## Music playback Music playback has finally arrived after a long time. The music dashboard can be accessed by long pressing the home button and selecting music dashboard. Including the following features - Music dashboard - Gapless playback - Volume normalization - Fade in/out when pausing and switching tracks that are not in the same album - Lyrics - Syncing of playlist albums tracks etc. The music playback is probably best considered to be in beta. While everything works there can and will be small bugs/annoyances. For AndroidTV navigation of the player controls are a bit cumbersome and will be improved along with other dPad improvements ## Picture-in-Picture ## Filters 2.0 + Library search improvements The filters in the library search view have now been improved.
